title: Logged model search order must end with a stable model_id tiebreaker unless the caller orders by model_id
answers: why do logged model search results change order between pages
make logged model pagination deterministic when sort keys tie
stable sort for logged models list page_token
body:
Invariant: The ORDER BY produced for search_logged_models always ends with a unique, stable key. _apply_order_by_search_logged_models appends creation_timestamp_ms desc when the caller did not sort by creation time, then appends SqlLoggedModel.model_id asc when the caller did not sort by model_id.
Enforcement: SqlAlchemyStore._apply_order_by_search_logged_models tracks has_creation_timestamp and has_model_id while iterating the user's order_by, so each tiebreaker is added at most once.
What breaks if skipped: When user sort keys tie, row order is undefined, so page_token-based pagination can repeat or skip models across pages.
Constraints: If a new sort field is added, keep the guard pattern (a has_<field> flag set during the loop) so the default tiebreaker is not duplicated; the test asserts the exact compiled ORDER BY clauses for the model_id case.
applies: Any change to how search_logged_models builds its ORDER BY or adds default sort keys.
says: Logged models appear duplicated or missing when clicking between pages in the model list.
The model catalog changes row order unpredictably when paging through tied sort results.
Browsing next pages of logged models shows items already seen on the previous page.
Ensure deterministic pagination when sorting logged models by columns with matching values.
search: In `mlflow/store/tracking/sqlalchemy_store.py`, `SqlAlchemyStore._apply_order_by_search_logged_models` appends `creation_timestamp_ms desc` and `SqlLoggedModel.model_id asc` as stable tiebreakers when those keys are absent from user ordering. Maintaining `has_creation_timestamp` and `has_model_id` flags prevents duplicate tiebreakers when adding sort fields. Without a stable unique tiebreaker, tied sort keys leave row ordering undefined and cause page-token pagination to repeat or skip models across pages.
